The full deploy is smaller than V3. Their measured exceptions and the aggregate ceiling are refreshed with narrow headroom; extension limits are retained. October 5 ML concept-application amendment: refresh only measured ML reference baselines and the narrow ceilings exceeded by the authorized existing-owner extensions; retain every unrelated budget and global/type ceiling.
